commentary.text: 90+7' The referee blows his whistle for the final time to end this match.
90+6' A header by Cedric Bakambu (Betis) from very close range goes towards the crossbar, but doesn't get past Ionut Radu, who makes a brilliant save.
90+5' A player from Celta Vigo pulled an opponent down, forcing the referee to blow his whistle. Betis are awarded the free kick.
90+4' Betis take a short corner instead of sending the ball into the penalty area.
90+2' Ilaix Moriba (Celta Vigo) gives the referee no choice but to show him a yellow card.
90+2' Some great play by Antony (Betis) ends with a shot on the edge of the box towards the bottom right corner, but Ionut Radu sees it all the way and makes a comfortable save.
90+1' Pablo Fornals (Betis) releases Cedric Bakambu with a precise pass and he attempts to finish, but is immediately surrounded by the defenders and loses the ball.
90' The fourth official shows 5 min. of added time.
90' Pablo Fornals (Betis) takes the corner but only sends it into a huddle of the defenders and one of them makes a good clearance.
90' Pablo Fornals (Betis) fails to send a pass into the box as his effort is cut out. Betis have a corner.
88' Sergi Altimira (Betis) attempts to find Antony with a delicate little through ball from inside the box, but one of the defending players makes a timely intervention.
87' The referee signals that it is time for a substitution and Sergi Altimira (Betis) will replace Alvaro Fidalgo.

85' That was a nice football moment. Aitor Ruibal (Betis) receives an amazing defence-splitting low pass on the edge of the box and blasts the ball towards the right post. Ionut Radu guesses his intention and dives superbly to deny him with a remarkable save!
83' A goal, which was scored by Borja Iglesias (Celta Vigo), was disallowed due to offside.
82' Oscar Mingueza (Celta Vigo) picks up a yellow card.
81' Antony (Betis) dinks a cross into the box in an attempt to find one of his teammates, but the defence manages to clear.
80' Manuel Pellegrini has decided to introduce fresh legs, with Cedric Bakambu (Betis) replacing Cucho Hernandez.
79' Substitution. Jones El Abdellaoui (Celta Vigo) receives a signal from the referee and is now allowed to enter the pitch as Pablo Duran walks off.
78' Williot Swedberg (Celta Vigo) goes on a solo run, but he fails to create a chance as an opposition player blocks him.
78' Aitor Ruibal (Betis) is penalised for holding. Jose Sanchez signals a set piece.
76' The corner is swung in but Celta Vigo can’t take advantage as a defender sweeps the ball away.
74' Pablo Fornals (Betis) is deemed to be in an offside position by the linesman and it looks like it is the right decision despite being a very close call.
73' Aitor Ruibal (Betis) receives a precise pass on the edge of the box and shoots. His poorly placed shot flies well wide of the right post.
72' Celta Vigo can’t profit from the corner as the defence clear the ball upfield.
70' The ball is out of play. Celta Vigo will have a chance to score from a corner.
70' Pablo Duran (Celta Vigo) passes the ball from the edge of the box in order to find his teammate, who is in a good scoring position, but the defender blocks the pass and spanks the ball to safety.
69' Williot Swedberg (Celta Vigo) sends a teasing cross into the area, but Alvaro Valles intercepts the ball.
67' It is time for a substitution. Valentin Gomez (Betis) is on for Junior Firpo.
67' Manuel Pellegrini prepares a substitution. Abde Ezzalzouli is replaced by Antony (Betis).
66' Claudio Giraldez is forced to make an unplanned substitution as Ferran Jutgla suffers an injury and Williot Swedberg (Celta Vigo) comes on.
66' A substitution has been made. Hugo Alvarez is replaced by Borja Iglesias (Celta Vigo).
64' Ferran Jutgla (Celta Vigo) is writhing in pain and can now receive medical treatment after the referee signals for the physio to come onto the pitch.
63' Pablo Fornals (Betis) takes the free kick which is inaccurate and the defence has no problem with the clearance.
62' Marcos Alonso (Celta Vigo) gets booked for the first time in this match.
62' Antony (Betis) makes it easy for the referee to show him a yellow card.
61' Cucho Hernandez (Betis) is given a fully deserved yellow card.
61' Shots on target – 3:3.
60' Alvaro Fidalgo (Betis) sends a long crossfield pass searching out one of his teammates, but his effort comes to nothing and they lose possession.
58' Claudio Giraldez decides to make a substitution. Alvaro Nunez will be replaced by Javier Rodriguez (Celta Vigo).
58' Substitution. Fernando Lopez makes way for Ilaix Moriba (Celta Vigo).
57' A pass into the penalty area from Hector Bellerin (Betis) is intercepted by the defence.
57' Betis are showcasing great team work and neat passing moves.
55' Abde Ezzalzouli (Betis) delivers a lovely cross into the penalty area. Nevertheless, an opposition defender is alert and averts the danger with a brilliant clearance.
53' Pablo Duran (Celta Vigo) fails to time his run beyond the last defender and the linesman makes a good call by signalling for offside after seeing the whole situation unfold.
53' Poor challenge! Natan (Betis) is penalised for tripping and Jose Sanchez blows his whistle. Celta Vigo earn a free kick.
52' The photographers scatter as a shot from the edge of the box by Marc Bartra (Betis) blazes well wide of the right post.
51' A cross by Aitor Ruibal (Betis) from the side of the pitch flies into the box, but fails to find its intended target as the aim was poor.
51' Betis seem to be finding their feet as they enjoy some possession. They are waiting for the right moment to create new attacking opportunities.
49' 1 - 1 Goal Hector Bellerin (Betis)! Hector Bellerin (Betis) was put through by Aitor Ruibal and he showed brilliant composure inside the box to fire into the right side of the net. 1:1.
49' A player from Celta Vigo takes his opponent down, the referee blows his whistle for a foul.
48' Cucho Hernandez (Betis) is in a clear offside position and the referee blows his whistle after the linesman raises his flag.
48' A cross into the box from Abde Ezzalzouli (Betis) is cleared.
46' Natan (Betis) looks to break free, but an opposing player clears the ball away. The ball goes out of play and Celta Vigo will have a goal kick.
46' The players are back out on the pitch following the half-time break and the second half is about to start.
45+2' The first half of today's match has just finished.
45+2' Abde Ezzalzouli (Betis) wastes a great chance as he climbs high around the penalty spot to connect with a cross from the resulting free kick. He produces a header which goes well over the bar.
45+1' One of the Celta Vigo players tripped an opponent and conceded a foul. Betis will take a free kick.
45+1' Sergio Carreira (Celta Vigo) sends a pass into the box, but his attempt is thwarted and cleared.
45' There will be a minimum of 1 min. of added time.

44' Abde Ezzalzouli (Betis) rises above the opponent's defence and heads a precise cross towards the middle of the goal. His effort, however, is blocked by Ionut Radu, who pulls off a comfortable save!

44' Pablo Duran (Celta Vigo) connected with a pass around the edge of the box, aimed and shot. His attempt went towards the middle of the target, but Alvaro Valles was alert and the score remains the same.
43' The referee and his assistant both point at the corner flag. Celta Vigo will have an opportunity to threaten the opposition's goal.
43' Pablo Duran (Celta Vigo) picks up an injury.
43' Hector Bellerin (Betis) crosses the ball forward but it is intercepted.
41' Abde Ezzalzouli (Betis) whips the ball into the penalty area, but one of the defenders is alert and spanks it away.
40' Some great controlled play and passing in the middle of the pitch from Celta Vigo.

38' Marc Bartra (Betis) reacts well and displays good awareness inside the box to get on the end of the resulting corner kick. He fails to direct the ball into the net as it flies narrowly over the crossbar.
38' Corner kick. Betis will have an opportunity.
37' A cross from a mid-range free kick, taken by Betis, is intercepted by one of the defenders.
35' Hector Bellerin (Betis) races towards goal but the defender gets back well to make a challenge.
34' Ferran Jutgla (Celta Vigo) swings a cross into the box, but it's far too close to Alvaro Valles, who smothers the ball.
33' Celta Vigo enjoy a period of possession as they are exchanging some passes and waiting for an opportunity to strike.
32' The cross into the penalty area from Marc Roca (Betis) needed to be more accurate in order to create a goal-scoring opportunity for his team.
31' Pablo Fornals (Betis) slides a pass forward, but one of the defenders cuts it out.
30' Pablo Duran (Celta Vigo) wastes a big opportunity! He controls the ball after a nice low pass and shoots from a promising distance. His poor effort goes miles wide of the right post.
30' A cross from a mid-range free kick, taken by Celta Vigo, is intercepted by one of the defenders.
29' One of the Betis players unfairly tackled his opponent and conceded a foul. Celta Vigo have been awarded a free kick.
28' Pablo Fornals (Betis) attempts to find one of his teammates, but puts far too much on the pass and the chance is gone.
27' Hector Bellerin (Betis) sends a cross into the box, but the opposition's defence clears the ball away to eliminate the danger.
26' Oscar Mingueza (Celta Vigo) passes the ball onto Fernando Lopez, but one of the defenders dispossesses him.
25' The Celta Vigo players are exchanging some short passes to try and open up the opposition’s defence and hit them swiftly on the break.
24' Hugo Sotelo (Celta Vigo) dinks a cross into the box from the free kick. However, the opposition defence thwarts the attack, preventing anyone from finishing.
23' A player from Betis brings down an opponent and commits a foul. Celta Vigo have a free kick.
22' The free kick from long range, taken by Betis, is intercepted by one of the defenders.
19' A long pass, executed by Fernando Lopez (Celta Vigo), missed the precision to reach his teammates.
18' Ferran Jutgla (Celta Vigo) finds himself behind the opposition's defence, but the game is stopped for offside.
17' Ferran Jutgla (Celta Vigo) meets a precise pass with a nice touch on the edge of the box and produces a shot to the middle of the goal. What an excellent save by the goalkeeper!
16' The ball is cleared after Pablo Fornals (Betis) attempted to dribble past an opposing player. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Celta Vigo.
15' The Betis players are exchanging some short passes.
14' Another attempt to send the ball beyond the defence by Aitor Ruibal (Betis) is thwarted and cleared to safety.
12' Hector Bellerin (Betis) delivers a promising cross into the box, but it's cleared.
11' This shall not pass! Cucho Hernandez (Betis) lines up a shot from the edge of the box and goes for goal, but the effort is well blocked by a defender.
10' Marcos Alonso (Celta Vigo) takes a shot from the edge of the box, but it's not a big threat for the goalkeeper as his effort is blocked by a defender.
10' Marcos Alonso (Celta Vigo) sends a promising through ball, but the defence is alert and cuts out the pass.
9' Aitor Ruibal (Betis) fails to find any of his teammates inside the box as his pass is blocked.
8' Aitor Ruibal (Betis) sends a cross into the box, but Ionut Radu comes off his line to gather the ball.
8' Celta Vigo control the tempo of the game by exchanging some accurate short passes.
7' Hugo Alvarez (Celta Vigo) wastes a good opportunity as his pass into the box is blocked by the defence.
4' 0 - 1 Ferran Jutgla (Celta Vigo) takes a great first touch to control a killer pass on the edge of the box and drills a shot into the bottom left corner in trademark fashion.
3' Neat passing move from Betis in order to create new attacking opportunities.
1' The referee blows his whistle and we are underway.
